seoTitle: JSON Lines Log Filter: Search Any Key in NDJSON Logs
metaDescription: Load JSON logs, flatten nested fields and filter by any key with =, !=, ~, > and <. Level summary and table. Free, runs in your browser.
intro: Flattens JSON log records to dotted keys and filters them with simple key conditions.
why:
Structured logs are easy to write and awkward to read. This tool flattens nested fields and lets you ask questions such as level=error;ctx.ms>1000 without jq.

It picks time, level and message columns first. The NDJSON viewer is better for plain sorting and CSV; this one is for filtering and summaries.
howTo: Paste JSON lines or choose a file.
Choose columns and sorting if needed.
Read the level summary and the matching rows.

faq.a: = != ~ (contains) !~ > < >= <=. Numbers compare as numbers when both sides are numeric.
With dots, like ctx.ms. Arrays of simple values are joined with commas.

faq.q: What if some lines do not match?
faq.a: They are skipped and the result says how many. Lines that are not JSON are counted and skipped.
No. Parsing happens in your browser and nothing is sent. Logs can hold IP addresses and tokens, so the page does not write them into the address bar.
